sources.title: Miss Fortune Build Guide: Fortune Favors The Bold (Critical Strike/Lethality Guide)

passive.name: Love Tap
passive.text: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

spells.name: Double Up
spells.text: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

spells.name: Strut
spells.text: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

spells.name: Make It Rain
spells.text: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

spells.name: Bullet Time
spells.text: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

damage.value: Miss Fortune deals burst damage with critical-strike or lethality builds.

archetype.value: Miss Fortune is a ranged marksman who brings burst and area-of-effect damage to the bottom lane.

axis.value: Miss Fortune plays lane as a bully with strong poke.

winCondition.value: Miss Fortune wins team fights with a strong ultimate and helps secure objectives.

spikes.why: Miss Fortune gains a strong power spike because it boosts Double Up and Bullet Time through their bonus critical strike effects.

spikes.at: Double Up’s cooldown falls to 3 seconds
spikes.why: Miss Fortune can fire it more often.

bait.why: When Double Up is on cooldown, Miss Fortune cannot use its two-target strike.
